name: expansion-e2b
description: Expansion wave E2B audit — the HDB entry + service-yard storage cluster: shoe-bench (open cubbies / flip fronts), wall-hook-rail (metal J-hooks / Shaker pegs, 5 & 8 hooks), pegboard (shelf+hooks / hooks / cups accessory kits), utility-cabinet (single/double door × flat-panel/louvre). Staged on open ground BESIDE the flat (mounted rail/pegboard read as clean product shots at their mount height, no wall occlusion) in the whole-flat ORBIT dollhouse camera whose ~3/4 elevation reveals float/attachment. Every requestFrameSelection closeup targets a joint: cushion→bench, hooks→board, shelf/cups→pegboard, proud door→carcass.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setQualityTier?.('high'); s.exitRoomEditor?.(); s.setCameraMode?.('orbit'); })()

steps.name: place-grid
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const items = [ ['shoe-bench',{}], ['shoe-bench',{style:'flip'}], ['wall-hook-rail',{}], ['wall-hook-rail',{style:'pegs'}], ['wall-hook-rail',{hooks:8}], ['pegboard',{}], ['pegboard',{kit:'hooks'}], ['pegboard',{kit:'cups'}], ['utility-cabinet',{}], ['utility-cabinet',{doors:'double'}], ['utility-cabinet',{doorStyle:'louvre'}], ['utility-cabinet',{doors:'double',doorStyle:'louvre'}] ]; const cols = 4; const dx = 1.7, dz = 2.2, x0 = 1.0, z0 = -6.5; const pos = {}; const list = items.map(([defId, props], i) => { const c = i % cols, r = Math.floor(i / cols); const x = x0 + c * dx, z = z0 + r * dz; const key = defId + ':' + JSON.stringify(props); pos[key] = [x, z]; return { id: 'audit-' + i, defId, position: [x, z], rotation: 0, props }; }); window.__auditPos = pos; s.setItems(list); return list.length; })()

steps.name: frame-bench-cubbies
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['shoe-bench:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0], 0.3, p[1]], radius: 0.95 }); })()

steps.name: frame-bench-cushion-joint
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['shoe-bench:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0], 0.44, p[1]+0.1], radius: 0.5 }); })()

steps.name: frame-rail-jhook
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['wall-hook-rail:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0], 1.6, p[1]+0.05], radius: 0.5 }); })()

steps.name: frame-peg-shelf
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['pegboard:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0], 1.3, p[1]+0.05], radius: 0.75 }); })()

steps.name: frame-util-single
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['utility-cabinet:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0], 1.0, p[1]], radius: 1.35 }); })()

steps.name: frame-util-base
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__auditPos['utility-cabinet:{}']; window.__store.getState().requestFrameSelection({ center: [p[0], 0.2, p[1]], radius: 0.55 }); })()
